biggest_catch: Pay is strictly per word ($0.005 base) — not hourly — so effective hourly earnings depend entirely on typing speed; slow typists can earn below minimum wage.
catches: Piece rate only: paid per word typed, never by the hour; effective hourly pay depends on typing speed and audio difficulty.
Must be an experienced typist residing in the U.S. or Canada (Puerto Rico excluded).
Evaluation process must be completed within 30 days of application approval or the application is disabled.
Minimum 15 scheduled hours per month required (up to 12 hours per day); must work all assigned jobs.
Jobs have fast turnaround: typically due within 2.0–2.2x the audio length.
Paid twice monthly by direct deposit (U.S. only) or check — no PayPal or other payment services.
Availability of work varies; no guaranteed volume.

c1.evidence: SpeakWrite — real operating transcription company since 1997; official Typist FAQs page on speakwrite.com loaded live.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Standard base pay is one-half cent per word, but many shifts offer a 10% bonus on top of that. SpeakWrite also offers additional bonuses and incentives.' Concrete per-unit rate stated.

c3.evidence: Official FAQ answers 'Why does your website ask me for a credit card? Is this a scam?' — 'No, that is the client side of our web site.' No fee to apply or work as a typist.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Payment is made twice per month, either by direct deposit (U.S. typists only) or by check. We do not use PayPal or other payment services at this time.'

eligibility: Experienced typists residing in the U.S. or Canada (Puerto Rico excluded); must complete the evaluation within 30 days of application approval.
notes: SpeakWrite hires independent-contractor typists for legal/business dictation transcription. Distinct from per-audio-minute transcription routes (TranscribeMe R0391, GoTranscript R0392, etc.) because pay is per word typed with scheduled shifts. Piece-rate framing is essential: the $0.005/word rate is exact; effective hourly earnings vary with typing speed and are not stated officially.
numeric_basis: payout from official per-word piece rate ($0.005/word base, $0.0055/word on shifts with the 10% bonus); time: transcription guide 30-60 min per typical assignment

payout_value_note: Official per-word piece rate: $0.005/word base, $0.0055/word on shifts with the 10% bonus; total pay per assignment varies with word count — piece rate is variable, not hourly.

s1.note: Experienced typist, U.S./Canada resident; Windows OS required for their software; foot pedal recommended but not required.

steps: Apply for the remote transcription typist role at speakwrite.com
Complete the evaluation/testing process within 30 days of application approval
Complete training and sign the security/confidentiality forms
Choose and schedule your shifts (up to 12 hours/day; minimum 15 scheduled hours/month)
Receive dictation jobs through the secure SpeakWrite Typist app
Complete each job within the recommended 2.0-2.2 turnaround ratio of job length
Get paid twice per month by direct deposit (U.S. only) or check
timing: Paid twice per month (direct deposit for U.S. typists, check otherwise); minimum 15 scheduled hours per month; jobs due within ~2.0-2.2x the audio length.
weasel_words: many shifts offer a 10% bonus (qualifier on the bonus, not the base rate)
